title: American Greed
description:
S12 E7 — Blood Relatives; End of Life Scam
A thieving shopaholic son murders his family to cash in on the family's wealth; a Chicago health facility owner uses an inflated billing scheme in a $20 million rip off.

title: American Greed
description:
S12 E8 — Dangerous Luxury
Vitaly Borker scores $18 million selling designer knock-off eyewear as genuine from his website in Brooklyn, N.Y.; when customers complain, they are threatened with violence, even murder.

title: American Greed
description:
S9 E11 — "Vintage" Wine Fraud
A counterfeit wine dealer dominates the fine wine scene, making millions selling his cheap basement blends through elite auction houses.

title: American Greed
description:
S14 E12 — A Father's Fraud
Karl Karlsen is a hardworking man with what seems to be a terrible streak of bad luck, as his wife and son both die in accidents nearly 20 years apart; Karl has a secret: their suspicious deaths have been keeping his bank account full.

title: American Greed
description:
S12 E16 — Just a Dollar and a Scheme; Lousy Landlord
An Iowa man rigs a $16.5 million lottery jackpot, triggering the biggest lottery scam in American history; notorious New York City landlord Steven Croman finds a new home in jail.

title: American Greed
description:
S15 E2 — Theranos CEO on Trial
Former employees, whistleblowers, and even a family friend-turned-foe provide new insights into the company's leadership and the mysterious long-term relationship between Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes and her top deputy, Sunny Balwani.

title: American Greed
description:
S9 E14 — Friends Without Benefits
Mutual Benefits buys life insurance policies from AIDS patients, the chronically ill and seniors and fraudulently resells them as low risk investments to clients.

title: American Greed
description:
S9 E15 — The Spy Who Scammed Me
A private security contractor promises to help win the freedom of detained oil executives and claims he can find out who abducted Madeleine McCann.

title: American Greed
description:
S15 E22 — Drunk With Power
With his long beard, ponytail, and ubiquitous advertising, Jamie Balagia - AKA The DWI Dude - is well-known in Texas as a flamboyant defense attorney who can get drunk driving defendants out of a jam.

title: American Greed
description:
S15 E23 — Fame, Fortune & Fraud
Jason Van Eman is a B-list actor from Oklahoma who decides to seek fame and fortune as a Hollywood producer.
